Small-cap financials (ABDA, YULE, BEKS, LPGI) are seeing speculative retail inflows, creating volatility that institutional investors should exploit via selective entry, not blanket exposure.
sectors.ai: Buy selective exposure to XCIS, LIFE, and ASMI on idiosyncratic catalysts, but keep overall financials underweight vs. index. The sector's flat aggregate masks a bifurcated tape: Indonesian names are outperforming US peers, yet the NORMAL signal argues against chasing broad beta. Rotate into high-momentum insurers and niche lenders, and trim laggards like BTPS if they fail to hold gains.

Subsector rotation favors discretionary-adjacent FMCG (BIKE, MGLV) over pure staples as urban wage growth and e-commerce penetration lift premium and convenience segments.
sectors.ai: Buy selective FMCG laggards with domestic revenue exposure (FOLK, SURI, KING) as ID outperformance (+0.33%) vs US (-0.71%) signals resilient local demand; momentum is broad but thin, so rotate into names with confirmed volume upticks and avoid chasing COIN/BAUT without earnings confirmation. Position for Q3 staples restocking and rural recovery, targeting 8-12% upside over 4-6 weeks.
